title_en: Stamp Tax Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
Article 1 Units and individuals that execute taxable instruments or conduct securities trading within the territory of the People's Republic of China shall be taxpayers of stamp tax, and shall pay stamp tax in accordance with the provisions of this Law.
Units and individuals that execute taxable instruments outside the territory of the People's Republic of China but use them within the territory shall pay stamp tax in accordance with the provisions of this Law.

Article 2 For the purposes of this Law, "taxable instruments" means contracts, documents of title transfer, and account books of business as listed in the Stamp Tax Tax Items and Tax Rates Table attached to this Law.

Article 3 For the purposes of this Law, "securities trading" means the transfer of stocks and stock-based depositary receipts traded on a stock exchange established according to law or other national securities trading venues approved by the State Council.
Stamp tax on securities trading shall be levied on the transferor of the securities trading, and shall not be levied on the transferee.
Article 4 The tax items and tax rates of stamp tax shall be implemented in accordance with the Stamp Tax Tax Items and Tax Rates Table attached to this Law.

Article 6 Where the amount is not stated in a taxable contract or document of title transfer, the tax basis for stamp tax shall be determined based on the amount actually settled.
If the tax basis still cannot be determined in accordance with the preceding paragraph, it shall be determined based on the market price at the time of executing the contract or document of title transfer; if government pricing or government-guided pricing shall be implemented according to law, it shall be determined in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State.

Article 7 Where there is no transfer price in securities trading, the tax basis shall be calculated and determined based on the closing price of the security on the previous trading day at the time of handling the transfer registration procedures; if there is no closing price, it shall be calculated and determined based on the face value of the security.
Article 8 The amount of stamp tax payable shall be calculated by multiplying the tax basis by the applicable tax rate.

Article 9 Where the same taxable instrument contains two or more tax item matters and the amounts are separately stated, the amount of tax payable shall be calculated separately according to the applicable tax item and tax rate for each; where the amounts are not separately stated, the higher tax rate shall apply.
Article 10 Where the same taxable instrument is executed by two or more parties, the amount of tax payable shall be calculated separately according to the respective amounts involved.

Article 11 For business account books on which stamp tax has been paid, if the total amount of paid-in capital (share capital) and capital surplus recorded in subsequent years increases compared with the total amount on which stamp tax has been paid, the amount of tax payable shall be calculated based on the increased portion.

Article 13 Where a taxpayer is a unit, it shall declare and pay stamp tax to the competent tax authority at the place where its organization is located; where a taxpayer is an individual, he or she shall declare and pay stamp tax to the competent tax authority at the place where the taxable instrument is executed or where the taxpayer resides.
Where the title to immovable property is transferred, the taxpayer shall declare and pay stamp tax to the competent tax authority at the place where the immovable property is located.

Article 14 Where a taxpayer is an overseas unit or individual and has an agent within the territory, the domestic agent shall be the withholding agent; where there is no agent within the territory, the taxpayer shall declare and pay stamp tax on its own, and the specific measures shall be prescribed by the tax authority under the State Council.
The securities registration and settlement institution shall be the withholding agent for stamp tax on securities trading, and shall declare and pay the tax and the interest on bank settlement to the competent tax authority at the place where its organization is located.

Article 15 The time when the tax liability for stamp tax arises shall be the date on which the taxpayer executes the taxable instrument or completes the securities trading.
The time when the withholding obligation for stamp tax on securities trading arises shall be the date on which the securities trading is completed.

Article 16 Stamp tax shall be levied on a quarterly, annual, or per-transaction basis. Where stamp tax is levied on a quarterly or annual basis, the taxpayer shall declare and pay the tax within fifteen days from the end of the quarter or year; where stamp tax is levied on a per-transaction basis, the taxpayer shall declare and pay the tax within fifteen days from the date when the tax liability arises.
Stamp tax on securities trading shall be paid on a weekly basis. The withholding agent for stamp tax on securities trading shall declare and pay the tax and the interest on bank settlement within five days from the end of each week.

Article 17 Stamp tax may be paid by affixing stamp tax stamps or by the tax authority issuing other tax payment certificates according to law.
Where stamp tax stamps are affixed on a taxable instrument, the taxpayer shall cancel each stamp by stamping or drawing across the perforations.
Stamp tax stamps shall be printed under the supervision of the tax authority under the State Council.

Article 18 Stamp tax shall be collected and administered by the tax authority in accordance with the provisions of this Law and the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Tax Collection.

Article 19 Where taxpayers, withholding agents, and tax authorities and their staff violate the provisions of this Law, legal liability shall be pursued in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Tax Collection and relevant laws and administrative regulations.

Article 20 This Law shall come into force as of July 1, 2022. The Interim Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Stamp Tax promulgated by the State Council on August 6, 1988 shall be abolished simultaneously.
